thesis: The page is the manual that should have come in the box: every section is a numbered step whose exploded drawing closes up as you read it, and each step's hardware bag counts the visit instead of the screws.

signature.name: Exploded Step + Hardware Bag
signature.summary: Graphite exploded-view line drawings whose parts slide shut along dashed explode lines via --sw-p, always paired with a zip-bag label (seal line, punched holes, mono BAG letter) that tallies the visit with facts only. Hero exploded dresser closes in the intro; Steps 01-06 each draw and close with a tomato tick; price table as a keyed parts inventory; reviews as bag tags; tools print as step lists; footer is Step 07, the empty hallway, drawing fully assembled.

palette.family: Instruction White + Cam Zinc + Tomato Step

layoutMoves: manual page grid: a 3-col margin rail (step number, exploded drawing, hardware bag) beside 8-col content, swapped left/right every other step
price table set as a keyed parts inventory (A-E rows, part silhouettes, mono leader dots, tabular figures)
services as a parts tray: hairline-boxed inventory grid with letter keys, not cards with photos
footer as Step 07 full-width: assembled drawing at large scale beside the call

motion.intro: Hero exploded dresser slides shut part by part (5 parts, 60ms stagger, <=1.1s) while the h1 line mask rises; any input skips to the end.
stories: stack: hero photo pinned while 3 numbered statements scroll past, each ticking at 50% (>=640px)
draw: Steps 01-06 drawings draw (DrawSVG) then close along explode lines via --sw-p; step circle ticks at .9
motion.hover: dimension line with end ticks grows scaleX 0->1 from left, 200ms
